Searched the web · NerdOctaxe TPS53667 error log
Handed to the team · Spare board availability is a stock/product question I cannot answer; warranty r

Hi,

Thanks for the details. That error points to the voltage regulator on the hashboard. The 12 TH/s NerdOctaxe uses a TPS53667 regulator, which powers all 8 chips. Other owners have reported the same fault: when it happens, the "VREG OVERHEATED" error stays even after the unit cools down, the regulator output reads 0 V and every chip shows 0 GH/s, while the fans and web interface keep working. A TPS fault like that is a problem on the board itself, so you can't fix it with a setting or a firmware reflash.

Please keep the unit unplugged for now. Powering it on again and again with a regulator fault won't help and could make things worse.

On your question about fully populated replacement boards: I can't see stock or spare parts, so I've passed it to the team. Someone will pick up your ticket and reply by email with an answer.

If you bought the miner from us, it may also be covered under warranty. To help the team check this quickly, please reply in this thread with:

1. Your order number
2. The full error lines from the log, as text or a screenshot (the TPS53667 status line plus the vin, vout and iout readings if they're shown)
3. Your firmware version
4. The power supply you're using (stock or another one, and its rating)
5. A short video of the unit booting with the error on screen, and a clear photo of the serial number label

If you'd like more help in the meantime, our Discord is very active: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf. Mention @nullhashrate (JD, our hardware lead) and he can take a look at your log.

Hal, HeliumDeploy Technical Support
